svg.aria-label: buildermesh across boxes: one NATS hub; hub-box, build-box and a laptop each run bmesh serve; a lead's events reach the map and its ask is pushed to the phone; a review job is taken by any box running the kind; a sleeping laptop's jobs wait on the hub and run in order when it wakes
svg.title: buildermesh across boxes

g.text: one NATS hub on a tailnet; every box
through the hub to hub-box's map
a review job waits in its kind's inbox;
a box running review takes it, replies
hub-box's daemon pushes the lead's ask
the laptop sleeps: level jobs from
bmesh sync on hub-box wait on the hub
it wakes, its leaf reconnects; it levels
one repo and holds a plugin's for approval
on wake: takes the jobs it missed

svg.text: every node on the mesh, live
